Home.title: Panama, explored with maps and data you can verify
Home.lead: A platform to discover, understand and plan trips across Panama. It relies on open sources and always shows where each piece of data comes from.

map.title: Map first
map.body: The experience starts with the land itself: terrain, coastline and real areas, with an equivalent list for anyone who does not use the map.

provenance.title: Every data point, with its provenance
provenance.body: We state the source, the license and when it was checked. If something is not verified, we say so.

languages.title: Five languages
languages.body: Spanish, English, Portuguese, French and German. Changing language keeps what you were looking at.

Home.statusBody: This is a development version. The destination pages are in preparation and the translations are pending human review.

Explore.title: Explore Panama
Explore.listDescription: This list is the text alternative to the map: it contains the same destinations.

Map.keyboardHelp: With focus on the map, use the arrow keys to pan, + and − to zoom, and Shift with the arrow keys to rotate. The destination list is the text alternative to the map.

unsupported.title: This browser cannot display the map
unsupported.body: The map needs WebGL, which is not available here. The destination list contains the same information.

error.title: The map could not be loaded
error.body: Preparing the map failed. The destination list is still available.

dataMissing.title: Base map data is not available
dataMissing.body: The cartography file was not found. The destination list is still available.

terrainError.title: Terrain could not be loaded
terrainError.body: The base map is shown without terrain.

Map.invalidLink: Part of the link was not valid and was ignored.
Map.referencePoint: The marker is a reference point derived from OpenStreetMap; it is not an official boundary.

layers.heading: Layers

protectedAreas.label: Protected areas
protectedAreas.hint: Polygons derived from OpenStreetMap, not official.

hillshade.label: Terrain shading
hillshade.hint: Third-party data: loads tiles from Amazon Web Services.

terrain3d.label: 3D terrain
terrain3d.hint: Third-party data: loads tiles from Amazon Web Services. Tilt the map to see it.

layers.thirdPartyNotice: With a terrain layer on, Amazon Web Services receives your IP address when tiles are requested.
layers.rightsPending: Turned off until the rights to this data are verified.

boundaries.label: Administrative boundaries
boundaries.hint: Country, province and district boundaries derived from OpenStreetMap via Overture; not official boundaries.

places.label: Places and place names
places.hint: Names as the source provides them; they are not translated.

waterways.label: Rivers and canals
waterways.hint: Waterways derived from OpenStreetMap; visible from zoom 7.

landcover.label: Land cover
landcover.hint: Forest, wetland, sand and reef derived from OpenStreetMap; visible from zoom 8.

controls.cooperativeMac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
controls.cooperativeWindows: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
controls.cooperativeMobile: Use two fingers to move the map

Map.cluster: {count} destinations grouped: {names}. Zoom the map in

blocked.title: The map is disabled in production
blocked.body: The usage rights for the map data have not yet been verified at their primary sources. The destination list is still available.

area.unnamed: Protected area with no name in the source
area.tileNote: The base map derives from OpenStreetMap via Overture; it is not an official boundary.
area.nameLocal: Local name from the source, not translated.
area.nameCommon: Name from the source in this language.
area.areaMethod: Calculated on the original geometry with {method}.
area.areaUnknown: Area unavailable: the calculation method is not known.
area.rightsProvisional: Rights: provisional (not yet read at the primary source).
area.noVerifiedData: There is no verified data on activities, access restrictions or how to get there for this area.
area.unavailable: The extended details are not available right now. Only what the map carries is shown.
area.blocked: The details are blocked until the rights to this data are verified.
area.notFound: This area has no published details.
area.frame: Show the area on the map

inView.heading: Protected areas in this view
inView.description: This list is the alternative to clicking the map: it contains the areas drawn in the current view.
inView.zoomIn: Zoom in to see fewer areas.
inView.empty: There are no protected areas in this view.
inView.layerOff: Turn on the “Protected areas” layer to choose areas.
inView.waiting: Waiting for the map to finish drawing.
inView.mapUnavailable: The map is not available, so there are no areas to list.

Destinations.indexLead: These are the initial destinations. For each one we show which data exists and which could not be checked.
Destinations.contentPending: The editorial page for this destination has not been written yet. We do not show descriptions without a verifiable source.
Destinations.evidenceNote: Assessed on {date}. It expires on {expires}; after that the status goes back to “Unknown”.

notes.homonymBaru: This is not the Barú district: they are different entities.
notes.homonymSantaCatalina: Other localities and one district share this name. Here we mean the coastal locality in Veraguas.
notes.bocasAmbiguous: “Bocas del Toro” names a province, a district and a locality at once. The exact scope of the destination is pending editorial definition.
notes.cascoNoBoundary: The official boundary of the historic district could not be consulted (source not reachable from the working environment). The map only marks a reference point derived from OpenStreetMap; it draws no boundary.
notes.homonymElValle: Another “El Valle” exists (a neighborhood in Chiriquí). Here we mean the locality in Coclé province.
notes.homonymCascoViejo: Another “Casco Viejo” exists in Veraguas province: it is not this one.

observation.geoCounty: District boundary derived from OpenStreetMap, not official.
observation.geoRegionCountyLocality: Province, district and locality: three distinct entities, derived from OpenStreetMap.
observation.geoLocality: Locality boundary derived from OpenStreetMap, not official.
observation.geoProtectedArea: Protected-area polygon derived from OpenStreetMap, not official.
observation.geoProtectedIsland: Island and park polygons derived from OpenStreetMap, not official.
observation.geoCanalLines: Water lines and polygons (canal, lake, locks) derived from OpenStreetMap; there is no official Canal zone.
observation.geoContainingLocality: Only the polygon of the locality that contains it (San Felipe) exists, derived from OpenStreetMap; it is not the boundary of the historic district.
observation.geoLocalityCorroborated: Polygon of the locality “El Valle” derived from OpenStreetMap, linked by containment of a volcano feature; not official.
observation.terrainLandNoBathymetry: Terrain on land; no bathymetry at high zoom.
observation.reasonNoCredential: No credential available to check it.
observation.reasonBlockedHost: Source not reachable from the working environment.

Editorial.fallbackNotice: This content is only available in {language}.
Editorial.outdatedNotice: The original text has changed; this translation may be out of date.

Sources.title: Sources and attributions
Sources.lead: All the geographic information in this version comes from the sources below. Licenses marked as provisional have not yet been read at their primary source.
Sources.blockedLead: They could not be consulted from the development environment. Until access and a license are in place, no boundary is presented as official.

rights.provisional: Provisional: not verified at the primary source

use.overture: Coastline, water, land cover, protected areas, administrative boundaries and localities, derived from OpenStreetMap.
use.awsTerrain: Terrain relief and shading on land. Loaded only if you turn on a terrain layer.
use.glyphs: Typeface for the map labels (Noto Sans glyphs).

Accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
Accessibility.lead: Our goal is to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA. This statement describes the real state, including known limitations.
Accessibility.keyboardBody: All navigation and the language selector can be used with the keyboard alone, and the focus is always visible.
Accessibility.textAlternativeBody: The map is a graphic canvas. The list of destinations contains the same information and is its accessible equivalent.
Accessibility.motionBody: We respect the system preference to reduce animations.
Accessibility.languagesBody: Spanish, English, Portuguese, French and German. The translations are pending human review.

limitations.map: The interactive map is not yet integrated in this version.
limitations.testing: Automated tests do not replace an evaluation with users, which has not been carried out yet.
limitations.screenReaders: It has not been tested with real screen readers.

Accessibility.contactBody: The channel for sending accessibility feedback is still to be defined.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: We could not find what you were looking for. The link may have changed.

reason.no_translation: there is no translation into this language yet.
reason.translation_not_published: there is no reviewed and published translation yet.
reason.translation_outdated: the translation is out of date.

Content.expired: {field}: the verified information expired on {date}. We do not show it because it may have changed.
Content.disputed: {field}: there is conflicting information under review. We do not show it until it is resolved.
Content.unknownLead: There is no verified information on these topics yet. That does not mean it does not exist: it means we have not yet checked it against a source.
